articles.title: A’s Zack Gelof sues Tigers over injury at Comerica Park, cites loss of future earnings
articles.description: At the heart of Gelof’s claim is a concern that his time missed will result in future lost earnings in salary arbitration.

articles.title: U.S. sprinter Sam Blaskowski ‘embarrassed and ashamed’ after club drops him for use of racial slurs
articles.description: The 23-year-old apologised for sharing the posts "almost seven years ago" which he thought "was a joke" and has left Star Athletics.
